draft_directions: simplest correct baseline — prioritize validity and robust handling of varied inputs over cleverness
sorting/preprocessing-based heuristic (e.g. handle the hardest elements first)
incremental best-choice heuristic: at each step take the locally optimal placement/decision
deterministic local search: start from a greedy solution, then iteratively improve it
robustness-first: parse/interpret the input tolerantly (accept rephrasings, synonyms, reordering, formatting variation) and normalize before solving, so the same intent always maps to the same answer
